notes.title: The Cabbage Effect is part of SUGOI showcase 2025!
notes.content:
A celebration of 34 terribly amazing indie games that will have you screaming SUGOI!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38050255/c81b1352377d0037828c3f402c3e2237af27f0f2.gif[/img]
And we’re thrilled to announce that The Cabbage Effect will be part of SUGOI happening TODAY:
Thursday, March 27! ⏰ 6:00 PM UTC / 7:00 PM CET / 2:00 PM ET

👉 Watch the stream, tune in now: https://youtu.be/Cud7vqpdEoA

Make sure to check out SUGOI Showcase 2025 Steam Event for the full lineup of amazing indie games!

👉 Steam event: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45443941/sale/SUGOIShowcase


Don’t miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342150/The_Cabbage_Effect/

notes.title: Going Rogue! Let's celebrate roguelike/roguelite games!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! We are part of the current "Going Rogue" festival on Steam! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/going_rogue/?tab=5]It's happening[/url] until May 9, a celebration of roguelikes, roguelites and metroidvanias.
We are continuously working, doing our best to bring you the effect: THE CABBAGE EFFECT
